noticeText.PROC-2026-00425: SPECIFIC PROCUREMENT NOTICE (PROCUREMENT OF GOODS/WORKS) Request for Bids Works (Two-envelope Bidding Process Without Prequalification) Employer: The Co-operative Republic of Guyana Project: Integrated Transport Corridors Project (ITCP) Contract Title: Rehabilitation and Upgrade of Mahaica Bridge to Abary Bridge Road Country: The Co-operative Republic of Guyana Credit No.: IDA-77040/ IDA-77050/ IDA-77060 RFB No: P501759-CW-1 Issued on: August 20, 2026 Corridor The Co-operative Republic of Guyana has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Integrated Transport Corridors Project (ITCP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for the Improvement (Rehabilitation and Upgrade) of the Selected Regional Road Corridor -Reconstruction of Existing Road Network on the East Coast Demerara – Lot 1: Mahaica Bridge to Abary Bridge Road Corridor (Km. 0+00 – Km. 27+10). The Ministry of Public Works now invites sealed Bids from eligible Applicants/Bidders for the construction of 27.1 kilometers of asphalt concrete road, along the Upper East Coast Demerara corridor in Guyana, extending from Mahaica River Bridge to Abary River Bridge. The works comprise a dual carriageway facility consisting of two lanes in each direction, separated carriageways, and paved shoulders 1.0 m to 1.5 m wide. The works include, but are not limited to, the improvement (rehabilitation and upgrade) of approx. 27 km of roadway. The Works includes for the relocation of existing utilities from within the Works limit, the construction of 10 No. 10-15m span prestressed precast concrete bridges, 750m precast box culverts, 20,120m in-stu concrete drains, 17,040m earthen drains, the installation of road furniture and traffic safety facilities as part of Road Safety improvements, and other ancillary works as specified in the Contract Documents. The Contract is expected to be completed within a period of 36 calendar months from the Commencement Date. Bidding will be conducted through the international competitive procurement using Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF BorrowersProcurement in Investment Projects Financing” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”) and is open to all eligible Bidders. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the Bidding Documents. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria (including technical and non-price factors): 60% for Technical Part and 40% for Financial Part. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the Ministry of Public Works and inspect the bidding document during office hours 09:00 hrs. to 16:00 hrs. Guyana Time at the Address 1 below. A complete set of Bidding Documents in English may be requested by eligible bidders upon the submission of a written application or email to Address 1 below. The document will be sent by email. Bids must be delivered to the Address 2 below on or before 09:00 hrs. Guyana Time on Friday, October 02, 2026 and be clearly marked “Request for Bids: Improvement (Rehabilitation and Upgrade) of the Selected Regional Road Corridor -Reconstruction of Existing Road Network on the East Coast Demerara – Lot 1: Mahaica Bridge to Abary Bridge Road Corridor (Km. 0+00 – Km. 27+10). Electronic bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. The outer Bid envelopes should also be marked “ORIGINAL BID or COPY”, and the inner envelopes marked “TECHNICAL PART” will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the Address 2 below at 09:00 hrs. Guyana Time on Friday, October 02, 2026. All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the National Procurement and Tender Administration Board (NPTAB) until the second public Bid opening. All Bids must be accompanied by a: (i) Bid Security of US$2,000,000 (Two Million United States Dollars); and (ii) Local Labour Method Statement. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document. All submissions must be in English and include three (3) hard copies [one (1) original and two (2) copies] and one (1) un-editable .pdf copy. The digital copy of the Technical Part and of the Financial Part shall each be in a separate flash drive. The addresses referred to above are: Address 1 The Permanent Secretary Ministry of Public Works Oranapai Towers Wright’s Lane, Kingston, Georgetown, Guyana. noticeText.PROC-2026-00427: GOVERNMENT OF GUYANA MINISTRY OF PUBLIC UTILITIES AND AVIATION GUYANA WATER INC. WATER SUPPLY IMPROVEMENT PROJECT (WSIP) ICB No: GWI – CDB – W101 – 2026 INVITATION TO BID – WORKS Supply and Installation of Transmission Mains at Leguan, Region # 3 The Government of Guyana (GOGY) has applied for financing from the Caribbean Development Bank (CDB) in an amount equivalent to Seventy-Six Million, Two Hundred and Forty-Nine Thousand (US$76,249,000) towards the cost of Water Supply Improvement Project (WSIP) and intends to apply a portion of the proceeds of this financing to eligible payments under a contract for which this invitation is issued. Payments by CDB will be made only at the request of the GOGY and upon approval by CDB and will be subject in all respects to the terms and conditions of the Financing Agreement. The Financing Agreement prohibits withdrawal from the financing account for the purpose of any payment to persons or entities, or for any import of goods, if such payment or import, to the knowledge of CDB, is prohibited by a decision of the United Nations Security Council taken under Chapter VII of the Charter of the United Nations. No party other than the GOGY shall derive any rights from the Financing Agreement or have any claim to the proceeds of the Financing. The Guyana Water Inc. (GWI) is the Executing Agency for this Project. GWI invites sealed bids from eligible and qualified bidders for the Supply and Installation of Transmission Mains at Leguan, Region # 3. The work consists of the installation of approximately 4.4km of 150mm PVC pipes on Leguan Island. The bidding process is conducted according to the procedures specified in the Procurement Procedures for Projects Financed by CDB (January, 2021), as published on CDB’s website and is open to all bidders from eligible countries. Eligible countries are member countries of CDB. Bidders are advised to review the relevant eligibility criteria detailed in Section 4 and conflict of interest provisions in Section 5 of the Procurement Procedures for Projects Financed by CDB (January, 2021), as published on CDB’s website. Firms whether applying individually or in the form of a Joint Venture, shall: (a) be legally incorporated or otherwise organised in, and have their principal place of business in an Eligible Country; (b) be more than fifty (50) percent beneficially owned by a citizen or citizens and/or a bona fide resident or residents of an Eligible Country, or by a body corporate or bodies meeting these requirements, as far as the ownership can be reasonably determined; and (c) shall have no arrangement and undertake not to make any arrangement whereby the majority of the financial benefits of the contract, i.e. more than fifty (50) percent of the value of the contract, will accrue or be paid to sub-contractors or sub-consultants that are not from an Eligible Country. Eligible bidders will be required to submit full qualification information with their bids establishing their eligibility to bid and qualification to perform the contract if the bid is accepted. Qualification requirements include, inter alia: • • a minimum average annual turnover of US$2,0000,000, (defined as certified payments received for works in progress or completed) within the last three (3) years. a demonstrable cash flow (including access to credit) of no less than US$220,000 and experience as prime contractor in the construction of at least two (2) Installation of HDPE/PVC Pipes of internal diameter of 300mm or greater, at depth of 1meter within the last five (5) years. Bidding and qualification information are to be submitted in the English Language on the prescribed forms inserted in the Bid Documents. Submissions that do not provide the information required or that do not demonstrate the prospective supplier’s ability to perform satisfactorily, will not qualify and will not be considered for further evaluation. Bid documents will be available for first inspection at the first address below, from August 28, 2026 at 11:00am (Guyana Time). A complete set of Bidding documents can be purchased by interested bidder upon payment of a non-refundable fee of Five Thousand Guyana Dollars (G$5,000) or a currency that is freely convertible . Requests may be made by personal application or in writing at procurement@guyanawaterinc.com; and christopherv@guyanawaterinc.com. Written applications must be clearly marked: “Request for Bid Documents for the Supply and Installation of Transmission Mains at Leguan, Region # 3.” Applicants who request that documents be forwarded to them must submit an account number from a local courier agent that accepts freight collect charges. The documents will be promptly dispatched, but under no circumstance will Government of Guyana, Guyana Water Inc. be held responsible for late delivery, loss or damage to the documents. The electronic Bidding submission procedures will not be accepted. Hard copies of Bids must be submitted in sealed envelopes, with the name and address of the bidder, and be clearly marked “Supply and Installation of Transmission Mains at Leguan, Region # 3)” and must be delivered to the third address below no later than October 6, 2026 at 9:00am (Guyana Time) Bids will be opened publicly immediately after the deadline for submission of bids, in the presence of Bidders' representatives who choose to attend at the second address below. Qualification information only must be submitted simultaneously to the third address below. Bid must be accompanied by a signed Bid-Securing Declaration. Late bids will be rejected. Government of Guyana, Guyana Water Inc. reserves the right to accept or reject any bid, and to annul the process and reject all bids, at any time prior to award of contract, without thereby incurring any liability to the affected prospective bidder(s) or any obligation to inform the affected prospective bidder(s) of the grounds for Government of Guyana, Guyana Water Inc. Bidding will be conducted through the National Competitive Bidding (NCB) process, specified in the Procurement Act 2003 and is open to all eligible bidders. 3. Interested eligible bidders may obtain further information from Ministry of Housing, Central Housing & Planning Authority; Projects Department (227-8886 / 226 – 1809) and inspect the Bidding Documents at the address mentioned above, from 09:00hrs – 15:30hrs. 4. A complete set of Bidding Documents in English (electronic copy on a flask drive) may be purchased by interested bidders from the Central Housing and Planning Authority’s Cashier at Plantation Houston along the Mandela to Eccles Highway, East Bank Demerara, Region #4 for a non - refundable amount of Ten Thousand Guyana Dollars (GYD$10,000). The method of payment shall be cash. [Documents can be uplifted from Tuesday, 15 September, 2026.] 5. Bids shall be accompanied by Bid Security calculated as follows; a) For bid prices up to GYD 100 Million, bid security – 2% of the bid price b) Above GYD 100 Million to GYD 500 Million, bid security – 1.5% of the bid price c) Above GYD 500 Million, bid security – 1% of the bid price 6. The delivery/construction period for each project listed above is Ten (10) months. 7. Envelopes shall: i. Contain the original (in paper) and 2 electronic copies (flash drive only) with an exact PDF version of the paper tender ii. Clearly indicate the name of the contract iii. Bear the warning “DO NOT OPEN BEFORE 09:00 HRS on Tuesday, October 6th, 2026. 8. Bids must be delivered to the Chairman, National Procurement and Tender Administration Board, Ministry of Finance (Northeastern Building), Main and Urquhart Street, Kingston, Georgetown, on or before 09:00 HRS on Tuesday, October 6th, 2026. 9. Late bids will be rejected. 10. Bids will be opened physically at 09:00 hrs. in the presence of the bidders’ representatives who choose to attend. 11. A bidder may submit bids for any or all the lots for the various projects. 12. (a) Contracts will be awarded to the lowest evaluated qualified bidder and only one lot will be awarded to any bidder in a Project Area. (b) In the event that one bidder is adjudged the lowest qualified bidder for more than one Lot, then the Evaluation Committee will recommend to the benefit of the Client, which LOT the bidder is recommended for. Chief Executive Officer ‐ Central Housing & Planning Authority (CHPA)
